commentary: Graded the two walks of the blind pair over each entry's file and cascade (test/helpers/user-docs.ts, test/core/user-docs/version.test.ts, the delta spec, design.md, proposal.md, tasks.md, CHANGELOG.md). The whole-ref parse is present at both rules it claims (the install-target failure and the install-command rule), and the token loop now defers to it, so a token inside a target is judged once. Beyond the walk's own tests, a probe ran the parser over an autolink `<...#v2.0.1>`, a Markdown link `(...#v2.0.1)`, an inline-code command followed by a period, and a stale target followed by a comma: each read as the rule says. The CHANGELOG clause names the writer the code has (the bash and zsh completion installers' `# OPENSPEC:START`), and design D3 matches it. Task 3.4's record agrees with the run's output, including the PATH caveat. The residual check over the diff from the external pass's commit found no file outside the walks' edit records. The full suite was green after the walk (177 files, 3747 tests) and `orbit validate release` is valid.
